root_cause.text: In `dmemcg_limit_write`, after parsing the region name from the user input, the code does not verify that the options string (the part after '=') is non-NULL before passing it to string comparison functions like `strcmp`, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when the input contains only a region name without any options (e.g., "test/region0").
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds an explicit check `if (!options || !*options)` immediately after extracting the region name, confirming that a NULL or empty options pointer was previously allowed. The crash backtrace shows `strcmp` with `RDI=0` (NULL), and the CVE description states the issue is triggered by `echo test/region0 > dmem.max`.
